titleZh: 当前 Windows 版本不受支持
detailEn:
This device reports {{osLabel}}. Cherry Studio requires {{minimum}} (64-bit) or later. Windows 7, 8, and 8.1 are not supported, including launches through third-party compatibility layers.

No data was changed. To continue, upgrade Windows or use a supported device. Past installers remain available on the releases page for reference only and receive no support or security updates.
